'''Landing Bay 17''' was located in [[Grig Starport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Narg]]. When the ''[[Worthless Fool]]'', an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]], arrived at Narg looking for the kidnapped [[Crying Dawn Singer]], it was berthed in Landing Bay 17.<ref name="Abduction">''[[The Abduction]]''</ref>
